verdict.rationale: Only a single thin mention of 'Smart Limits on cards' on the spend-management page hints at spend controls, but there is no documentation of category-, merchant-, or amount-based restrictions, nor evidence of real-time auto-lock/decline at point of sale. Missing for 10: detailed docs on category/merchant/amount rule configuration, evidence of real-time POS blocking/auto-lock behavior, and independent corroboration of these controls working in practice.
